decisions.decision: Autonomous Browser QA becomes a permanent part of MatchPilot governance. For every PR that changes the site, the frontend, the APIs the browser reads or visible behaviour, unit tests, integration tests, a build, green CI without browser evidence or a code-only AI review are not enough: a Browser QA Gate on a really running environment is mandatory (WEB CHANGE + NO VERIFIED BROWSER QA = MERGE BLOCKED). An unexecuted check is never PASS. Exemptions only through the verifiable automatic impact classification. Level A deterministic (Playwright, real Chromium, isolated QA database, fixtures, desktop and mobile, interactions, screenshots, traces, console/JS/HTTP errors, basic accessibility, repeatable regressions, locally and in CI without Render); level B exploratory AI agent, which does not replace level A and stays NOT VERIFIED when not available or authorized. Every confirmed bug yields a regression test where possible. Severity P0 security/integrity/gravely wrong, P1 main function unusable or substantially wrong result, P2 limited defect with workaround, P3 visual/minor; confirmed open P0/P1 block the gate, P2/P3 may be deferred only with recorded reason, impact and follow-up. Each gate produces a verifiable report (commit SHA, environment and browser, software version, dataset, journeys, counts, JS and HTTP errors, screenshots, traces, findings, limitations, verdict) kept as CI artifact, without secrets. An automatic control blocks certification of a web PR without valid Browser QA evidence for the actual head, resistant to missing or stale artifacts, unexplained skips, incomplete reports, PASS without execution, later changes and arbitrary exemptions; branch protection and required checks must be verified; changing repository protections needs owner authorization. No Render deploy or reactivation, no production Neon writes or migrations, no new paid services, no real money or exchange execution, no destructive data changes, no unprotected public QA environments. PR #163 is not invalidated; the rule applies to web changes after its verified activation. Phases: A audit (read-only), B deterministic gate, C exploratory agent, D end-to-end certification; HARD CERTIFIED only when environment, interactions, defect detection, reproducibility, re-check of fixes, refusal of invalid evidence, non-bypassability and the separately tested exploratory agent are all demonstrated.

decisions.decision: Permanent product rule for every present and future page, component, mobile and desktop screen and feature of the ordinary MatchPilot interface: it never shows raw text, developer text, technical descriptions, internal identifiers, table names, dataset paths, pipeline states, API keys, diagnostic or debug messages or implementation jargon, nor superfluous explanatory text under titles, cards, tables or controls; MatchPilot looks and behaves like a professional football analysis and trading platform. Examples to remove from the Daily Board: 'Le partite di un giorno nei dati salvati…', 'Orari come forniti dal fornitore', 'ora del fornitore', 'Fase: Storico · dataset: spain/laliga/2024-2025', 'Stato risultato' when redundant; they are examples of a systemic problem, not the whole of it. Sports and financial information (1X2, Over/Under, both teams to score, results, xG) is shown with professional, readable, compact and consistent components; missing data is shown discreetly, never invented, keeping absent distinct from zero; information needed to understand the data (time, origin, state when relevant) stays accessible with a non-technical presentation; diagnostics, technical provenance, identifiers and metadata stay in the systems and in dedicated technical views; mobile and desktop meet the same standard; no fictitious features, simulated data or unverified content to improve the look. A global audit classifies every text of every page and component (useful to the user, redundant, technical internal, necessary to redesign visually) in a matrix with current text, position, proposed action and verification test; the work is not complete after the Daily Board alone. The rule is recorded in the canonical product registers and the roadmap; the global cleanup is planned inside V-B, in small verifiable PRs, without interrupting the PR sequence. Every such PR: desktop and mobile tests in a real browser, before/after screenshots, a check that no real data is lost, a check of technical strings and regressions, Gate A/B, CI and independent review, no merge with blocking findings. Acceptance: no user screen looks like a debug page, a technical report or a raw prototype. No Render or Neon change, no deploy, no cost without authorization.

decisions.title: STOP / ADVISORY_ONLY
decisions.decision: In STOP or ADVISORY_ONLY no new virtual position may be opened. Positions opened before STOP stay manageable: simulated close, hedge and cashout only when they actually reduce the exposure of the existing position; settlement, commission, ledger updates, reconciliation and recovery allowed; P/L of open positions keeps being computed and shown; advisory-only operations create no financial position. A confirmed settlement of a pre-existing position updates the Money Management progressions exactly once, also during STOP, idempotent and crash-recoverable. STOP blocks new exposure, not the correct accounting of earlier exposure. Scope: paper trading and virtual positions only; no real-money execution.

DEC-010 — Retention dei backup
SCELTA APPROVATA: A
Adottare una politica unificata di conservazione:
- 14 punti di ripristino giornalieri.
- Copie settimanali e mensili secondo spazio disponibile, necessità di recupero e costi già autorizzati.
- Applicazione anche al PostgreSQL 18 operativo.
- Integrità, cifratura e verificabilità dei backup.
- Conservazione esterna alla macchina operativa.
- Protezione delle copie storiche speciali e degli archivi sottoposti a freeze.
Prima di abilitare cancellazioni automatiche:
1. Verificare almeno un ripristino completo.
2. Simulare la retention senza cancellare nulla.
3. Elencare esattamente i file candidati alla cancellazione.
4. Verificare che non siano copie protette o l'unica copia recuperabile.
5. Sottoporre all'owner l'attivazione delle cancellazioni automatiche.
Questa ratifica approva la politica di conservazione, non autorizza immediatamente cancellazioni irreversibili.

DEC-013 — Default Money Management
SCELTA APPROVATA: A
Default ufficiali:
Bankroll "SHARED_ACCOUNT_BANKROLL"
Il capitale è condiviso tra i profili, con contabilizzazione coerente dell'esposizione.
La modalità segregata può essere prevista come opzione configurabile.
VOID / PUSH
Le operazioni VOID/PUSH non fanno avanzare la progressione del Money Management per default.
Eventuali varianti devono essere esplicite e configurabili, se previste dai contratti.
Commissione
La configurazione della commissione viene fissata al momento del matched/fill simulato.
Il settlement utilizza la configurazione storica associata all'operazione, senza applicare retroattivamente modifiche successive.
Tutti i calcoli monetari devono utilizzare aritmetica decimale appropriata, non floating point non controllato.
Questi default non introducono limiti monetari fissi arbitrari.

OWNER — MATCHPILOT / AUTORIZZAZIONE AUTO-DEPLOY (t123u, 2026-10-22 18:02 Rome)

Approvo il passaggio a un sistema di deploy completamente automatico sulla VPS, senza approvazione manuale GitHub per ogni release ordinaria.
Revoco il precedente requisito owner di approvazione umana per i deploy ordinari.
Autorizzo la riconfigurazione dell'environment GitHub e dei gate S1/S2/S3/S4 per supportare questo comportamento.

Condizioni obbligatorie:
1. Deploy soltanto dopo merge autorizzato su "main".
2. CI e test obbligatori verdi.
3. SHA esatto verificato.
4. Nessuna possibilità di bypass tramite altri workflow o re-run non autorizzati.
5. Correzione e verifica del difetto dei permessi di "mp-deploy v3".
6. Health check post-deploy.
7. Rollback automatico in caso di errore.
8. Nessuna migrazione distruttiva o cancellazione di dati automatica.
9. TotalCorner spento; PostgreSQL 18 e storico preservati.
10. Notifica Telegram operativa sull'esito del deploy.

Implementazione:
- Verifica prima l'architettura attuale dei gate.
- Modifica soltanto i controlli necessari.
- Esegui test positivi e negativi in ambiente isolato.
- Dimostra che l'auto-deploy non indebolisce i controlli.
- Attiva il nuovo comportamento soltanto dopo test completi.
- Registra la rettifica owner e aggiorna la roadmap.

L'agente può sviluppare, testare e revisionare il proprio codice, come già deciso.
Non introdurre nuovi account, revisori indipendenti o approvazioni manuali non necessarie.
Obiettivo: PR → test → merge autorizzato → deploy automatico → verifica → rollback se necessario.
Procedi senza ulteriori richieste per attività già autorizzate. Non aggirare le protezioni esistenti: riconfigurale correttamente secondo questa nuova policy.

Precisazione owner t124u (18:04): controllare soltanto che la CI sia verde non basta; verificare che i controlli siano quelli obbligatori e attendibili, riferiti esattamente al commit distribuito, e che un workflow modificato nella stessa PR non possa falsificarli. Se nel frattempo arriva un nuovo commit su main, il deploy precedente deve essere annullato o bloccato.

decisions.title: Universal capability, zero arbitrary defaults and future-proof architecture
decisions.decision: Owner product decision MP-PRODUCT-100 (summarized). MatchPilot is a universal, configurable, extensible platform ready for a possible future distribution to other users. Developers and AI agents may not choose arbitrarily which markets, selections, lines, statistics, competitions, seasons, bookmakers or features to privilege: ZERO ARBITRARY LIMITATIONS. The target is 100% of the functions and data really accessible through each authorized provider (within plan, licences, availability, quality, technical limits and usage rights), measured against a verified inventory, never declared from documentation alone; no invented capability; no default that narrows the user's possibilities; neutral technical defaults (security, performance, usability) are allowed if documented, modifiable where appropriate and never presented as owner preferences. Hard-coded filters such as Over 2.5, home price, favourite price or total xG may stay as optional shortcuts but never as the fixed set: the fix is architectural (capability-driven: a backend catalog of capabilities with stable internal id, provider and original id, type, market, selection, line/handicap, unit, operators, pre-match/live/historical availability, coverage, timestamps and provenance, state and limits; raw data kept; no information lost in normalization; semantically different markets never merged by name). Universal advanced search (any attribute, market, selection, line, price ranges, statistics, AND/OR groups, saved searches, neutral reset, missing data shown, historical/pre-match/live distinguished, missing never zero, no post-event data for earlier decisions) and the same principle in Match Center, Oggi, Simulazione, Backtest, Strategie, Archivio, Confronto, Dati and Strumenti (Tools keep their certification and follow the mandatory re-certification before any logic change); reuse what is correct, no indiscriminate rewrite. Architecture prepared for future multi-user distribution (per-user settings, saved searches, data separation, roles, isolation, capabilities per plan/provider, scalability, observability, security, accessibility, phone/tablet/desktop, localization and time zones, compatibility with future licensing) without implementing payments, subscriptions, commercial licences or SaaS without an owner decision; provider contracts must be checked for redistribution, display and commercial use.
